title: Binary workbook dates and duration
evidence_method: All sheets inspected with python-calamine 0.8.2, CPython 3.12.3; XML containers also inspected with zipfile and ElementTree. Values are source observations, not Markdown expectations. Second pass: complete BIFF8/BIFF12 sheet record inventory using Microsoft record specifications; olefile 0.47 reads XLS OLE streams and xlrd 2.0.2 independently decompiles XLS formula tokens in an isolated uv environment.

sheets.name: Sheet1

formulas.evidence: Complete BIFF12 sheet record scan; BrtFmlaString=8, BrtFmlaNum=9, BrtFmlaBool=10, BrtFmlaError=11; cached fields decoded directly.

sheets.object_presence_evidence: Zero BrtDrawing, BrtLegacyDrawing, BrtLegacyDrawingHF, BrtBkHim and BrtListPart records; no related ZIP parts or relationship targets.

limitations: Cell types are binding-decoded types, not original numeric storage or display formatting. Grid dimensions include leading empty areas and end at the last stored value.
No visual rendering, formula recalculation, chart rendering or macro execution was performed.
Null trailing_source_blank_extent means styled or unused cells outside the value grid were not measured. No exhaustive style, comment, external-link or validation audit.
Structural inventory is complete for sheet values, formula counts/caches, merges and table/chart/image presence. It is not a full binary-format conformance or rendering audit.
XLSB formula token payloads are recorded with type, location and cached result; formula expressions were not decompiled or recalculated.
package_object_evidence: ZIP member names, relationship targets and every worksheet BIFF12 record inspected. No drawing, legacy drawing, background-image or table-part records; no chart, drawing, VML, image or table relationship/part.
title_basis: Descriptive annotation title; source has no document title cell.
